cohort_name: AI Cohort 31-Day Enterprise AI Engineering Program

topics.objectives: Understand attention mechanisms, token limits, and context windows.
Master few-shot prompting, CoT, and system prompt design.
Enforce strict output schemas using Pydantic and function calling.
Implement automated evaluation frameworks (BLEU, ROUGE, LLM-as-a-Judge).
Defend against indirect prompt injection and data exfiltration.
Understand dense embeddings, cosine similarity, and dimensionality.
Configure indexing, HNSW algorithms, and hybrid search.
Implement semantic chunking, recursive splitting, and overlap optimization.
Combine keyword sparse retrieval with dense vector search.
Deploy Cohere/BGE re-rankers to improve precision at top-k.
Build hierarchical summarization and knowledge graph augmented RAG.
Measure faithfulness, answer relevance, and context recall.
Implement Reason-Act-Observe loops for tool execution.
Design hierarchical multi-agent teams with specialized roles.
Manage short-term context and long-term episodic vector memory.

topics.topic: Tool Use & Function Calling at Scale
topics.objectives: Register dynamic APIs and schemas for autonomous agent invocation.
Enable autonomous plan generation, error recovery, and reflection.
Implement approval gates and safety checkpoints for autonomous agents.
Test agentic execution across diverse interactive benchmarks.
Understand MCP client-server architecture and open standard primitives.
Implement resources, prompts, and tools in Python/TypeScript.
Securely bridge LLM clients with enterprise databases and APIs.
Manage permissions, authentication, and sandboxing for MCP servers.
Scale MCP servers in containerized cloud environments.
Apply GGUF, AWQ, and vLLM for high-throughput low-latency serving.
Implement semantic caching and token-bucket rate limiting for LLM APIs.
Trace agentic execution steps and debug latency bottlenecks.
Manage model routing between frontier and open-source models.
Scrub sensitive data and enforce enterprise data privacy policies.
Fine-tune open-source LLMs on domain-specific datasets.
Design end-to-end production-ready generative AI systems.
